text: Ilse's sister Fern is pregnant again, due in March. Ilse is going to be an auntie for the third time and she's thrilled.

James has a second interview at the bank on Friday at 3pm. He's really nervous about the panel part because last time he froze on the competency questions. His wife Olivia is making him rehearse answers every night this week, which he says is making it worse. Text him good luck Friday morning, and ask how it went over the weekend.
Kofi and his wife Esme are having the baby christened next Sunday at 11. I'm doing the cake.
Rhys didn't get the job at the council. He seemed flat about it but says he's already applied for two more.
Paolo's mum has her hip operation on Tuesday morning. He's driving up tomorrow night to stay with her for the week.
Need to post the card for Aaliyah's new baby before the weekend. A little boy, Noah, born on Saturday at 6.40am.
Jamal mentioned his brother Idris has started applying for apprenticeships. Idris wants to be an electrician like their dad.
Pick up the dry cleaning tomorrow morning and get a birthday card for Mum.
Isabel says her partner is completely obsessed with sourdough at the moment. Apparently there is a starter called Gerald living in their fridge.
Anjali got the job! She starts at the hospital pharmacy a week on Monday. Must send her flowers.
Duc's interview has been moved to next Thursday at half 10. He's prepping all weekend.

Bridget's daughter Mia is starting nursery in a fortnight, three mornings a week. Bridget is dreading the first drop-off more than Mia is. She's also going back to the office part time from the same week, so it's a lot of change at once. Her husband works nights and can't help with the mornings. Offer to do the Thursday pickup if she needs it.
Lunch with Jada was lovely. Her little one, Thabo, is crawling everywhere now and has two teeth.
Olivia's baby shower is off; she's been told to rest until the birth. I should drop round with some food on Saturday afternoon instead.
Karan has a phone screen with a fintech company tomorrow at 9am. He's been out of work since June, so this one really matters to him. Remember to ask him how it went tomorrow evening.
Stefan's dog Biscuit had his teeth out at the vet yesterday. He's groggy but eating again.
Elena is doing a part-time course in UX design on Wednesday evenings. She hates her current job in insurance claims and wants out by next summer.

Patrick and his wife Mai are expecting twins! Twelve-week scan was this morning. They're telling the family at Sunday lunch. Mai's parents have no idea yet. Patrick says they'll probably need a bigger car and they're already looking at houses with an extra bedroom, though nothing is decided. Mai has been really tired but otherwise fine.

Ignacio's son is applying to universities this month. Ignacio sounded more stressed about it than the boy is. Personal statement has to be in by the 15th, and they're visiting Bristol and Exeter open days this Saturday and next. His wife thinks he's pushing too hard. Their younger one has just started secondary as well.
Don't forget Adebayo's daughter's christening on the 12th at half 9. St Mark's, then lunch at their house.
Bruno asked me to be a referee for his application at the library. I need to email the form back to them by Friday at 5.
Varun's wife had the baby last night. A girl, Asha, 7lb 2oz. Both doing well. He sounded exhausted and very happy.
Tamar has been struggling since the miscarriage in August. She doesn't want to talk about it much but appreciated the message. Check in on her again next week.
Thabo's uncle is over from Durban for a fortnight. Thabo wants to take him up to the Lakes this weekend.
Fern says Ilse's interview for the head of year post is next Tuesday. Wish Ilse luck on Monday night; Fern says she won't mention it herself.
Gym at 7am tomorrow, then dentist at 2. Remember the parking permit.
James Hughes, Jimmy to everyone at work, is leaving at the end of the month. He's got a new role in Leeds and his partner's coming with him.
Rhys's girlfriend is pregnant. Early days, so keep it quiet, but they're over the moon. Baby is due in May.
Kofi's mum is coming to stay for six weeks when the baby arrives. Kofi is quietly terrified.
Paolo hinted that Esme would love one of those engraved silver bracelets for the christening gift. Her birthstone is sapphire.

Jamal had his final interview at the agency on Monday. Still no word. He's convinced he messed up the presentation, but the recruiter told him it was between him and one other person. His girlfriend Jada keeps telling him to stop refreshing his email. Text him on Friday afternoon to see if he's heard anything.
Xavier says his sister Aaliyah has been offered a place on the midwifery course starting in January. She's been trying for three years.
Isabel's son Duc is home from uni this weekend for his cousin's christening on Sunday at 2pm.
Anjali's husband Karan has an interview in Manchester on Wednesday. If he gets it they'll move before the baby comes in spring. She's worried about leaving her parents.
Bridget mentioned her brother Stefan has a new baby, his first. They're calling him Teddy.
Must ring Jada tonight about the christening plans. She wants me to be godmother and needs an answer by Friday.
Esme is still very sick with the pregnancy, twenty weeks now. Morning sickness all day. She's off work until at least next month.

Olivia told me that her mum's retirement party has been cancelled because her dad is in hospital. He went in on Saturday night with chest pains. Olivia is driving down tomorrow morning and will stay through to Thursday. I should send something to the house for her mum, maybe flowers or a hamper, and call Olivia on Wednesday evening to see how he is.
Karan doesn't drink at all, so get alcohol-free fizz for Saturday.
Stefan's partner Elena starts her new job on Monday. Head of marketing at a charity in town.
Patrick's daughter has a scholarship interview at the grammar school next Tuesday at 4. She's eleven and very shy. Patrick asked if I could do a practice run with her on Saturday morning.

Mai is going back to work after maternity leave in a fortnight. Her mother-in-law is having the baby three days a week, and nursery covers the other two. She's nervous about it, mostly about whether she'll still be up to speed after a year off. Her team has had a reorganisation while she's been away and her old manager has left.
Idris has been signed off with stress since the redundancy talks started. His boss still hasn't confirmed anything. Give him a ring at the weekend.
Book the car in for its MOT. Garage said Thursday or Friday next week.
Ignacio and Tamar's housewarming is on Saturday from 7. They've asked people not to bring flowers because Tamar has hay fever.

Called Adebayo back. His application for the senior engineer role went in this morning, and he hears in about ten days. He's pretending he doesn't care, but he really wants it. Ask him how it's going next Friday.

Bruno's cat Pepper has gone missing. She's been out since Tuesday night. He's put posters up all round the estate and his kids have been out every evening calling for her. She's chipped, so the vet will ring if anyone hands her in. He's gutted. I should check the garages behind ours tomorrow morning and drop him a message either way.
Varun mentioned his older brother is a paediatric nurse at the Royal. Might be worth asking him about the nursing course for Mia.

Tamar's sister Fern had the baby this morning at 8.15! A boy, no name yet. Tamar is heading to the hospital after work. Fern was in labour for nearly twenty hours, poor thing, and her partner Bruno nearly missed it because he was stuck on a train from London. They're hoping to be home by Wednesday. Get a card and something small for the baby before I see them.
Nice long call with Thabo. He's doing loads of running again, aiming for the half marathon in April, and has finally given up sugar in his tea.
Kofi's group interview went well yesterday afternoon. He'll hear back on Monday or Tuesday. Remind me to message him Tuesday night if he hasn't said anything.

Ilse's eldest, Rhys, has a job interview at the garden centre on Saturday at 10. It's his first ever interview and he's very anxious. Ilse asked if I'd give him a few tips over FaceTime tomorrow evening.
Paolo's partner has been offered the job in Lisbon. They're deciding by the end of next week whether to go. Paolo is torn because of his mum.
Aaliyah's twins are being christened on Sunday the 9th at 12. She's asked us to bring a dish for the lunch after.
Note to self: I'm taking Mum to her eye appointment on Thursday at 11, so leave work early.
Jamal Walsh was at the school gate. His wife's expecting their fourth in January! He looks shattered already.
Elena loves anything to do with Studio Ghibli and keeps saying she wants the Totoro cookbook. Good gift idea for her birthday in December.

Xavier has a final round with the airline tomorrow at 1.30, then hears by Friday. His partner is away on a work trip so he's on his own with the dog this week. Send him a good luck text tomorrow lunchtime.

Noah Kim, my old manager, got in touch about a role in his team. Interview probably next Wednesday morning, though he'll confirm the time on Monday. It's a step up and the pay is better, but it would mean two days a week in the Birmingham office. I need to update my CV this weekend and dig out the portfolio from the Hughes project.
Mia's christening went beautifully. Bridget cried through the whole thing. Must send her the photos tonight.
